events.title: The Apple Security Update Review for September 2026
events.summary: Apple released a major security patch covering 273 unique CVEs across all macOS, iOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS and Xcode, marking a significant software update.
events.why_it_matters: Several patches have high CVSS scores (up to 9.8), indicating severe vulnerabilities that could impact users of Apple’s operating systems if they remain unpatched. The breadth of updates stresses the need for timely patching across a diverse ecosystem.

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-65400 as exploited in the wild, added 2026-08-18, with US federal agencies due to fix it by 2026-08-21.
CVE-2026-84609 is rated 9.8 (critical) under CVSS 3.1 by CISA in the CVE record, the highest of the 550 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-23918 being exploited in the next 30 days at 50%, the highest of the 550 CVEs here.

Take an extended break from your regularly scheduled activities as we let’s take a look at the latest security patches from Adobe and Microsoft.
